test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Looking at / clouds in the / sky, I think / it will raining.
solution:
The correct answer is** "Option 2".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in this sentence is in the future simple tense verb.
 
• The phrase "it will raining" incorrectly uses 'raining' after 'will'.
 
• The correct future tense form should be "it will rain."
 
• Therefore, after correction, the sentence reads, "Looking at clouds in the sky, I think it will rain."

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• Options 1 ('Looking at'), 3 ('clouds in the'), and 4 ('sky, I think') are all grammatically correct as written.
 
• Option 2 ('it will raining') is incorrect as the verb form 'raining' after 'will' is not grammatically accurate; the base form 'rain' is the appropriate choice.
